text:
Ruth (Marketing): Quick preflight — finalizing launch blog. Two asks: 1) confirm hero visual choice, 2) lock webinar hook + HubSpot mapping. Can we do a quick pass? :eyes:
Ali (Content): Hero A (cloud + latency graph) felt strongest in tests. I still want to test CTA phrasing: "See latency in action" vs "See Redwood in production".
Marcus (Growth): For UTMs use utm_campaign=redwood-launch-1 and utm_content=hero-A/hero-B. We'll need exact final strings for the landing page form mapping.
Neha (Design): Uploaded variants here: https://figma.com/s/heroA and https://figma.com/s/heroB. Hero A is slightly busier but tells the performance story. Hero B cleaner.
Sam (Events): Webinar speaker slots confirmed: CTO + product lead. We have 30 min demo + 15 min Q&A. Need a short hook sentence for registration copy.
Ali (Content): Draft hooks: 1) "How we serve 10k req/s with predictable latency" 2) "Cut inference costs without trading quality" 3) "Behind the scenes of production LLM serving". Leaning toward 1.
Ruth (Marketing): Prefer #1 but soften to be product-led: "How we keep inference fast and predictable at scale". Also need a 1-sentence blurb for the blog header.
Marcus (Growth): HubSpot form fields: name, company, email, role, company_size, interested_in (checkbox: hosted,dedicated,private). Please confirm label text so we can map inbound properly.
Neha (Design): Suggest moving the CTA into the hero (inline) for conversion. Mobile stack looks good. Can we also add a secondary micrograph showcasing the benchmark? small svg.
Ali (Content): Blog header blurb: "Redwood Inference delivers consistent, low-latency LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments — here’s how we built it." Thoughts?
Sam (Events): Registration copy: "Live demo: See Redwood's inference runtime in action — design decisions that keep latency predictable." CTA button: "Register — live demo".
Ruth (Marketing): Approvals needed: legal check on claims (latency/cost numbers), Dev sign-off on benchmark methodology, design sign-off on hero. Marketing approve copy. Can each owner reply with OK or any blockers?
Marcus (Growth): OK on mapping. I'll set up the HubSpot form once we finalize labels. Can legal give a quick pass by EOD?
Ali (Content): I need dev notes for the benchmark box. @publish-bot can you paste the benchmark snippet used in the doc last week?
publish-bot: Attached: "99th p50 latency: 120ms; throughput: 9.8k rps; environment: 8x A100s, batch=16, kv-cache enabled" (automated snippet)
Neha (Design): OK on hero A if we simplify the graph — reduce labels. Will add micrograph SVG. ETA 4pm PT.
Sam (Events): OK on registration copy. Need the final demo timeline to put on the webinar page by 3pm.
Ruth (Marketing): Legal — can you chime in? @Maya (Legal)
Maya (Legal): Quick read — we should change "10k req/s" to "~10k req/s" and add a brief methodology footnote. Otherwise OK. Send me the benchmark page link.
Ruth (Marketing): Good. Ali will add methodology footnote. Marcus, once you create HubSpot form share the URL in this thread. If everyone replies with OK I'll trigger preflight checklist and schedule the embargo. :white_check_mark:
Ali (Content): Will add methodology note and update CTA phrasing to Ruth's version. Will post updated draft by 2:30pm.
Marcus (Growth): Will create HS form and share mapping by 2pm.
Neha (Design): OK — will upload final assets to /marketing/assets/launch by 4pm.
Sam (Events): OK
Maya (Legal): OK pending final link
Ruth (Marketing): Thanks team — if no other blockers we'll aim to publish next Tuesday and run webinar two weeks after. :tada:
